text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo gave it everything she had. Her 
running threw the race into absolute 
chaos. And what's more—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps out of sheer exhaustion, she 
showed off moves like a moonwalk. Fitting 
for a festival of racing, she thrilled the 
crowd.
